svg.text: The isolated Hyper-V bridge: a time-boxed Windows 7 VM that reaches the instrument and nothing else

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The host stays patched and managed on the corporate NIC; the guest owns the instrument NIC through a vSwitch the host cannot use, and has no other network at all.

svg.text: Why Generation 1, static memory, automatic start and a legacy adapter

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Windows 7 only boots as a Generation 1 VM; dynamic memory is off so control timing is predictable; AutomaticStartAction brings the guest back after a host reboot; the guest sees no network until the

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: integration components update is installed, so it starts on a legacy adapter.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Windows 7 has had no security fixes since January 2023, so the guest must never see the corporate network; confirm guest licensing. Controls: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); EU GMP Annex 11; GAMP 5.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
